crossRefs.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has…
“ ‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
“Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has…
“ ‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done…
One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”
“Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against…
One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’ ”
You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel…

translations.web: “ ‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,
translations.bsb: And if one of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the LORD’s commandments, he incurs guilt.
translations.kjv: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
translations.asv: And if any one of the common people sin unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Jehovah hath commanded not to be done, and be guilty;
